board.name: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education, Pune
board.summary: The Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education, with its head office in Pune, is an autonomous body under Maharashtra Act No. 41 of 1965. It conducts the SSC (Class 10) and HSC (Class 12) examinations through nine divisional boards, with a main and a supplementary examination each year. Its site explains the Class Improvement Scheme, marks verification, photocopies and revaluation, and offers digital marksheets on the board site and DigiLocker.

intro: Three Maharashtra cities have tuition-jobs pages with zones: Mumbai (with Thane and Navi Mumbai), Pune and Nagpur. Tutors there should choose zones on those pages. For Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Kolhapur, Solapur, Amravati, Nanded and the state's other towns, this page is where you begin. Name your town and the parts of it you can reach. A home request is offered first to the nearest suitable tutors, so being exact about your base matters. Online lessons are matched on subject, class and board, not on where you live, and are open to you straight away.

Maharashtra students may take the SSC and HSC through the state board, which works through nine divisional boards, or follow CBSE, ICSE or another board. List each board you can teach and the medium, such as Marathi or English. The board's site has its evaluation pages and FAQs, which are worth reading before a demo. Every request gives the parent two or three tutors with fees visible; the first class is a free demo, you set the fee, and families may switch later. Tutors who teach junior college classes should name their HSC subjects.

faqs: I live in Thane. Which page should I use?

Thane is covered by the Mumbai tuition-jobs page, along with Navi Mumbai, so pick your zones there. This state page is for tutors in Nashik, Kolhapur, Solapur and other towns without a page of their own.
What should I know about SSC evaluation?

The state board's site sets out its evaluation pages and FAQs, including the Class Improvement Scheme and marks verification after results. A tutor who has read them can answer a parent's questions in the demo without guessing.
How are tutors matched to a family?

NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, nearest first, then zone, city and online. The parent compares fees before the demo, the first class is free for the family, and switching later is free for them.
